newsitem.title: USA: Disney unit buys stake in LatAm HBO distributers.
newsitem.headline: Disney unit buys stake in LatAm HBO distributers.

text.p: Walt Disney Co's Buena Vista International Television Tuesday said it will acquire an equity interest in cable television distributers HBO Ole and HBO Brazil as part of an exclusive long-term pay television licensing agreement with the two entities.

Through its distribution agreement with HBO Ole and HBO Brazil, BVI-TV will license exclusive pay television rights for live action films. The firm said plans are also underway for the launch of a Disney Channel in the region soon but no commitments have been made to any distributors.
HBO Ole is a partnership of Time Warner Inc's Home Box Office and Warner Bros., Sony Corp's Sony Pictures Entertainment, Ole Communications.
HBO Brazil is a partnership those same firms and TVA, the television branch of Brazil's Abril Group.
